note: The evaluation set for `python3 -m stage_ready evaluate`. Every item is labelled BEFORE the loop runs on it — from how it was constructed (a synthesised defect) or by looking at the recording (a real one). Labels name the defects present in the input and the outcome a careful operator would accept; the loop is scored against them. `defects` map to finding/gate ids in `defect_map`. Sources are relative to the Red Curtain archive (~/mts); workdirs are the pipeline's, produced by demo/eval/derive_eval.sh + the pipeline (`evaluate --prepare`).
